modifications: Selected only 26 original elements for 16 bilateral shoulder/arm muscles; preserved heads and deltoid portions as components under editorial muscle parents.
Every source triangle and individual FMA/FJ identity retained. No decimation, mirroring, synthesis, per-mesh centering, custom registration or joining.
Shared transform (x,y,z) source millimetres to (x,z,-y) metres, identical to the skeleton.
Spanish labels and regional grouping are curated navigation. Composite parent IDs use the editorial med3d namespace, not invented FMA identifiers.
Assigned untextured red display material; Meshopt preserves float32 positions and quantizes normals to 12 bits; decoded geometry is checked against all source triangles.
Current publisher CC BY 4.0 declaration updated 2025-02-27; original OBJ legacy CC BY-SA 2.1 Japan headers remain in the preserved source ZIP.

provenance.author: Database Center for Life Science (DBCLS), Japan

modifications: Selected only the 34 audited original elements representing 26 bilateral torso/scapular muscle units. Pectoralis major and trapezius portions remain components.
All original triangles, FMA/FJ and side identities retained; no per-mesh fitting, normalization, mirroring, synthesis or simplification.
Shared transform (x,y,z) to (x,z,-y)/1000; float32 positions; Meshopt and 12-bit display normals as Phase 3A.
Regional and muscle-parent navigation is anatomically curated, not an automatic conversion of IS-A to PART-OF.
Current CC BY 4.0 publisher declaration; original legacy license headers preserved. No clinical validation.

coverage.title: Sistema muscular · hombro, brazo y torso
coverage.note: 42 unidades musculares bilaterales representadas por 60 mallas: 16 de hombro/brazo y 26 de torso. Las porciones no se cuentan como músculos adicionales.
limitations: Cobertura parcial: no es la musculatura completa del cuerpo ni del torso.
No se identificaron recto abdominal, oblicuo interno, transverso abdominal ni dorsal ancho en el inventario BP3D 4.0 auditado.
Intercostales aplazados: los elementos no identifican de forma inequívoca lado y espacio intercostal.
Atlas masculino adulto modelado; no representa variación individual ni acredita precisión clínica.
Origen e inserción son texto educativo; no hay zonas de fijación anotadas sobre las mallas.
